answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 15554 Country: India Title: AS SALAAMU ALAIKUM mufti sahab .Is it the SUNNATH to recite tasbhi e fatima and other wazeefas soon after the namaaz, even with out a dua or should we do a dua and then recite tasbhi e fatima.or which is the best way. Question: AS SALAAMU ALAIKUM mufti sahab .Is it the SUNNATH to recite tasbhi e fatima and other wazeefas soon after the namaaz, even with out a dua or should we do a dua and then recite tasbhi e fatima.or which is the best way. Answer ID: 15554 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1425/1357=B/1430) It is better to perform sunnah after the salah which are followed by sunnah muakkadah like Zuhr, Maghrib and Isha. The Tasbih Fatimah and other things should be recited later. As there is no sunnah muakkadah after Asr and Fajr, so Tasbih Fatimah and other things can be recited, whether before dua or after dua. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
